start a call.note: Existing majority ('Lancer un appel'); 'démarrer' also appears — prefer 'lancer'.

join a call.note: Majority rendering; one existing string uses 'Joindre l'appel', but 'joindre' is reserved for attachments per community rules.

end a call.note: Existing: 'Terminer l'appel pour tout le monde'. Distinct from 'quitter' (leave).

recording.note: Masculine. Record call: 'enregistrer l'appel'. Same word as 'save' contexts — disambiguate from 'Enregistrer' buttons when space allows.

raise hand.note: Existing rendering; 'a levé la main' for the past event.

screen share.note: Verb: 'partager son écran'. Presenting maps to the same vocabulary ('présenter' is not used in existing strings).

mute.note: Microphone context; same wording as channel mute. Muted: 'en sourdine'.

unmute.note: Existing button wording; 'enlever la sourdine' also appears in prose — either is acceptable, be consistent per surface.

mute others.note: Existing; Mute participant: 'Mettre en sourdine le participant'.

pop out.note: Existing fr.json uses 'Sortir', which reads as 'exit' and is misleading; 'détacher (la fenêtre)' is recommended and matches the desktop glossary.

speaker view.note: Not yet translated; aligns with Zoom/Teams French ('Intervenant'). Switch to speaker view: 'Passer à la vue de l'intervenant'.

grid view.note: Not yet translated; 'Passer à la vue en grille'.

blur background.note: Not yet translated. 'arrière-plan' (not 'fond') per community rules; blur intensity: 'intensité du flou'.

meeting summary.note: Existing: 'Créer un résumé de la réunion'.
